Along our journey to commercialize Pbxwall, we engaged with international resellers, heads of ICT and security, to further develop our services to protect critical infrastructure from other cyber threats such as TDoS (telephony denial of service), phishing and eavesdropping.

Our patent-protected algorithms have allowed us to develop innovative, first-of-kind mitigation techniques that proactively detect and block the aforementioned fraudulent call activities without compromising on service.  Unlike existing preventative solutions that depend on human intervention, Pbxwall automatically combats these crimes at their very core, 24x7x365.

Pbxwall will work with enterprises to help defend their brand and protect shareholder value, for example Pbxwall now provides UC vulnerability assessments and penetration testing services which are accompanied by in-depth reporting and actionable recommendations.

Our mission is to be acknowledged as the global market leader in the prevention of cyber crimes that threaten critical telephony infrastructures such as UC, PBX and contact centre solutions.

Name: H2020-Caladan
Description:
The CALADAN project brings together a supply chain that will enable automatic wafer-scale assembly of Terabit/s capable optical engines through the use of the micro transfer printing technology. 

Both SiGe BiCMOS driver and receiver chiplets (fabricated using a modified version of an established SiGe process), as well as GaAs quantum dot laser coupons will be transfer printed on 300mm Silicon Photonic wafers. The purpose is the parallel assembly of optical transceiver engines, thus significantly reducing production costs compared to conventional sequential flip-chip assembly processes. In addition fast vision-based automatic fiber attachment equipment and processes are being developed, again with the view to lower the cost associated with manufacturing of ultra high-speed optical transceivers.

The European project Caladan is an initiative of the Photonics Public Private Partnership (PPP), and has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 innovation programme under grant agreement No 825453.

Name: DataRaider Ltd
Description:
DataRaider supply multi-service convergent Self-Care and Call Centre solutions primarily for  telecom operators.

Mobile operators are experiencing a significant squeezing of their margins. The amount and complexity of business that they are doing is continually growing but the returns are in decline. In addition, operators are facing an onslaught from an array of non traditional competitors such as Apple, Google, Skype, etc. This is eating into their revenues, and undermining the viability of their product lines. Many operators are actively diversifying their business into areas such as on-line shopping, music/video/apps/ebook downloads, credit cards & banking, travel, insurance, etc. The expectation is that this will lead to a greater average return per user (ARPU).

The customer care call centre is one of the biggest inhibitors when it comes to diversification. Each new product line that an operator takes on simply adds to the complexity, scope and scale of the call centre. An operator with 1 million subscribers handles circa 3 - 4 million calls to its call centre per annum. The average cost to the operator of handling each call is €3 - €5.  DataRaider Self-Care automates 75% of customer care operations. This presents a significant opportunity for cost savings. It works for telephony, shopping, downloads, credit cards and banking, etc. This makes it a critical enabler for business diversification also.

Visit our website at http://dataraider.com

Description:
EllaLink is an advanced subsea cable system offering secure high-capacity connectivity on a unique low-latency transatlantic route serving the growing needs of the Latin American and European markets. The EllaLink network directly connects Brazil and Europe, linking the major hubs of São Paulo and Fortaleza with Lisbon, Madrid and Marseille. 

The EllaLink System is developed with state-of-the-art coherent technology, initially offering 100Tbps of capacity over four fibre pairs. In addition, the landing sites in Praia Grande (Brazil), Fortaleza (Brazil) and Sines (Portugal) have been secured. 

EllaLink is a privately funded and independent company committed to providing products and services on a Carrier Neutral and Open Access basis. 

To learn more, visit ella.link or getintouch@ella.link

Secure | Fast | Diverse | Open

Secure – The EllaLink System offers Customers a secure route between Europe and Latin America. The subsea system is buried and armoured to protect it from external damage, with most of the cable in the safer deep water. Its connectivity guards against cyber security threats.
 
Fast – EllaLink provides direct access between PoPs in Europe and Latin America via a shorter, new and unique path. The System has been specifically designed to reduce latency between major Sao Paulo, Lisbon, Madrid and Marseille hubs. Improvements in Round Trip Delay of up to 50% are possible between Madrid and Sao Paulo.
 
Diverse – EllaLink’s unique route offers geographic diversity from existing transatlantic systems and provides customers with an alternative route between the two continents, both on the submarine section and land. The diverse terrestrial routes to Sao Paulo, Madrid and Marseille ensure high end-to-end system availability. 
 
Open – EllaLink is a privately funded and independent company committed to providing Products and Services on a Carrier Neutral, Open Access and Independent basis.
